engines_meta.label: RHVoice
engines_meta.commercial_review: yes — 9 of the 14 Russian voices are CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (non-commercial); aleksandr-hq is CC-BY-SA-4.0; the rest LGPL-2.1+ per the Debian copyright file.
engines_meta.stress_handling: Honors U+0301: «пи́шу»/«бе́рега» change the audio; a mark matching default stress gives byte-identical audio (measured in phase 1). Deterministic.

engines_meta.label: Piper

voices.ru-irinia-medium: GPLv2 per the voice's MODEL_CARD (dataset: RHVoice); fine-tuned from the en_US lessac medium voice

engines_meta.commercial_review: yes — voice is GPLv2 per its model card and is a fine-tune of the lessac voice, whose dataset terms need separate review.
engines_meta.partial_blocker: The other Russian Piper voices (ru_RU-denis/dmitri/ruslan/irina-medium) are hosted only on huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices — CONNECT 403 here. Only ru-irinia-medium is available as a GitHub release asset.
engines_meta.stress_handling: espeak-ng ignores U+0301 and mis-stresses words containing it (dictionary miss → letter rules): «перейти́» → pʲirʲˈejtʲi vs unmarked pʲirʲijtʲˈɪ (phase 1).

engines_meta.label: XTTS v2
engines_meta.model: coqui/XTTS-v2 @ 28ac75746581 (tag v2.0.1; identical files to v2.0.0) — model.pth sha256 a9bf08409cde…; NOT the newer v2.0.3 on main
engines_meta.python_package: coqui-tts 0.27.5 (idiap fork) + transformers 4.57.6 + spacy 3.8.16 (needed by its sentence splitter), torch 2.6.0 CPU
engines_meta.gpu_required: no — runs on CPU; GPU would only speed it up

license.model: Coqui Public Model License 1.0.0 — non-commercial use of the model AND its outputs only

voices.en_sample: reference clip from the CPML-licensed model repo

engines_meta.commercial_review: yes — CPML forbids commercial use of the model and its outputs; Coqui (the licensor) has shut down, so a commercial license cannot be bought.
engines_meta.voice: cloned from samples/en_sample.wav shipped in the model repo (the ModelScope mirror has no speakers_xtts.pth; no Russian sample exists in the repo)
engines_meta.stress_handling: Tokenizer vocab has no U+0301: every mark becomes an [UNK] token and breaks the BPE split around it («за́мок» → за·[UNK]·мо·к vs «замок» → за·мо·к). Marks also count toward the 182-char Russian limit and can trigger sentence splitting (#22).
engines_meta.network_notes: Weights: huggingface.co API reachable, but its LFS/Xet CDNs (us.aws.cdn.hf.co, cas-server.xethub.hf.co) are refused (CONNECT 403), so files came from modelscope.cn with SHA-256 verified against the HF revision. torch from PyPI (download.pytorch.org redirects to download-r2.pytorch.org, refused).

engines_meta.label: Qwen3-TTS
engines_meta.model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice @ 0c0e3051f131 (built-in speakers serena, ryan; float32 on CPU)
engines_meta.gpu_required: no — runs on CPU, but peak RSS reached 13.5 GB of 15.7 GB (float32 1.7B); the 0.6B variant would need less
engines_meta.voice: built-in CustomVoice speakers; none is a native Russian speaker (README: Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean natives)
engines_meta.stress_handling: No text normalization; byte-level BPE keeps U+0301 as its own token (5 marks → 5 tokens in #04), so marks reach the model.
engines_meta.rate_support: no speed parameter; 1.7B takes a natural-language instruction (used for the two slow items, recorded)

voices.builtin: conds.pt, part of the MIT model repo

engines_meta.commercial_review: light — MIT. Output carries Resemble's Perth imperceptible watermark by default.
engines_meta.stress_handling: Vocab HAS a U+0301 token and the model is trained on stressed Russian: marks reach the model as their own tokens. The package would auto-stress Russian via an optional `russian_text_stresser` module, which is not a declared dependency and was not installable → skipped with a warning (recorded per synthesis). NFKD also splits й into и+U+0306.
engines_meta.rate_support: none — no speed/duration control; slow items synthesized at default rate
engines_meta.network_notes: Weights: huggingface.co API reachable, but its LFS/Xet CDNs (us.aws.cdn.hf.co, cas-server.xethub.hf.co) are refused (CONNECT 403), so files came from modelscope.cn with SHA-256 verified against the HF revision. torch from PyPI (download.pytorch.org redirects to download-r2.pytorch.org, refused).
